notes: Branch sections in this document carry no standalone branch ID token; the heading supplies only name, class, and cost. The id and filename are composed as <weaponId>-<branch-name-kebab-case>.
weaponId and weaponName come from the enclosing '## W-CE — Reactor Pulse' heading (line 374).
`rules` holds every bullet of this section verbatim with its source line; `effects` is a structured restatement of those same bullets and introduces no value that is not written in them.

Section prose states no prerequisite. prerequisites is empty per docs/65-weapon-stat-and-branch-upgrades.md:50,66 ("Branches have no stat-rank prerequisites"; no rank, level, time, or boss prerequisite).
Exclusivity and irreversibility are not restated in this section; they come from docs/65-weapon-stat-and-branch-upgrades.md:56,68 and apply to all 45 branches.

expectedEffect is null: no bullet in this section is phrased as an 'Expected effect' estimate, unlike some earlier branch sections in this document. The section's own numeric outcomes are transcribed in `effects` and every bullet is preserved verbatim in `rules`, so nothing is lost.

exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.
availability.purchase: Installing one is a single deterministic purchase costing exactly two units of its assigned specialized material.

effects.chargeConsumption: Charges are consumed by the next pulse and replaced by the count that pulse hits.

rules.text: Every enemy hit by a pulse gives one Critical Mass charge for the next pulse, capped at 20 charges.
Each charge gives the next pulse +2% Damage and +1% radius, for maximum bonuses of +40% Damage and +20% radius.
Charges are consumed by the next pulse and replaced by the count that pulse hits, allowing sustained crowd contact to maintain the bonus.
A boss alone supplies one charge; the large benefit requires horde pressure around it.
